product.title: Manhattan Sky Tour: New York Helicopter Flight

description.text: Take to the air for a compact helicopter sightseeing flight above Manhattan and New York Harbor. This route is designed for travelers who want a high-impact skyline experience in a short window, with aerial views of headline landmarks and live pilot commentary that helps orient first-time and repeat visitors alike.

highlights: Helicopter sightseeing flight focused on Manhattan skyline landmarks
Aerial perspective on New York Harbor features including the Statue of Liberty
Pilot-led route commentary during the flight
Time-efficient way to add a bucket-list NYC experience to a packed itinerary
exclusions: Heliport and security fees where applicable

start.description: Departs from Downtown Manhattan Heliport, 6 East River Piers, New York, NY 10004. Exact check-in and manifest instructions are provided after booking.

product.itinerarySummary: Check in at the Downtown Manhattan Heliport, complete preflight safety and manifest procedures, then depart on a Manhattan skyline flight that traces Lower Manhattan and New York Harbor landmarks before running northbound over the skyline corridor and returning to the heliport.

itineraryItems.title: Downtown Manhattan Heliport check-in
itineraryItems.description: Arrive, present valid photo ID, and complete security and manifest procedures before boarding.

itineraryItems.title: Governors Island
itineraryItems.description: After takeoff, pass the south harbor edge with views toward Governors Island and New York Harbor traffic lanes.

itineraryItems.title: Statue of Liberty
itineraryItems.description: A signature fly-by view of the Statue of Liberty from above New York Harbor.

itineraryItems.title: Ellis Island
itineraryItems.description: Continue across the harbor corridor for aerial views of Ellis Island and the former immigration station complex.

itineraryItems.title: One World Trade Center
itineraryItems.description: Track back toward Lower Manhattan for skyline views anchored by One World Trade Center.

itineraryItems.title: Empire State Building
itineraryItems.description: Follow the Midtown skyline corridor with aerial perspective on the Empire State Building district.

itineraryItems.title: Chrysler Building
itineraryItems.description: See the Chrysler Building and adjacent Midtown East towers as the flight continues northbound.

itineraryItems.title: Central Park
itineraryItems.description: Weather and air-traffic permitting, the route reaches the southern edge of Central Park before turning back downtown.

itineraryItems.title: Manhattan skyline helicopter flight return leg
itineraryItems.description: Return south over the Manhattan skyline and descend back to the Downtown Manhattan Heliport.

additionalInfo: All passengers must present government-issued photo ID
Passenger and cabin weight limits apply and are verified by the operator
Flights are weather dependent and may be rescheduled for safety
Arrive early to allow time for check-in and security screening

items.question: Where does the Manhattan Sky Tour depart from?
items.answer: This helicopter tour departs from the Downtown Manhattan Heliport at 6 East River Piers in Lower Manhattan.

items.question: How long is the helicopter portion of the experience?
items.answer: The in-air sightseeing segment is approximately 18 minutes, with extra time needed for check-in and safety procedures.

items.question: What happens if weather conditions are not flyable?
items.answer: The operator may reschedule the flight or provide a refund according to the booking terms when weather prevents safe operations.
